task_definition.description: Main is RED on the whole-tree silent-fallthrough gate (shared/tests/test_silent_fallthrough_gate.py::TestWholeTreeGate::test_no_violations_outside_allowlist fails deterministically). Single offending site: fused-memory/src/fused_memory/backends/sqlite_task_backend.py:1197 SqliteTaskBackend.get_statuses_fresh — its broad `except Exception: return {}` fail-open (intentional per docstring "fails open to {} per the any-error contract") logs NOTHING, which violates the gate. FIX: add a logger.warning(...) (or logger.error, exc_info=True) call immediately before the `return {}` in that except block — keep the documented fail-open behaviour but make it non-silent so the gate passes. One-line change scoped to that one method. (Do NOT weaken the fail-open contract; do NOT allowlist unless logging proves infeasible.)
